name: Activity
description: A live timeline of agents, worktrees, flows and boxes: what happened while you were away.

name: Box monitor
description: Memory, disk and load on every box, with an hour of history and a warning before one runs out.

name: Dev servers
description: Every dev server on every box, by worktree: open it in a tab, copy its URL, start or stop the repo's services.

name: Git changes
description: What changed in a worktree: files, diffs, and commit or push when you're happy with it.

name: Issues
description: Open GitHub issues for your projects, and an agent on any of them in one step.

name: Notes
description: A scratchpad per worktree, kept in the worktree as .berth/notes.md so its agents can read it too.

name: Prompt library
description: Saved prompts with {{variables}}: send one to an agent from ⌘K or a pane's menu, or to several agents at once.

name: Pull request
description: The worktree branch's pull request: checks, reviews and comments, or open one.

name: Usage & accounts
description: Tokens by agent, model, project and session on each box, from the agents' own records, and switching which Claude Code or Codex login new sessions use.
